acceptance: SnowflakeAdapter.__init__ accepts gateway (values from the manifest gateways declaration: native/espresso/greybeam/custom), gateway_host, gateway_port, gateway_protocol=https, gateway_ca_bundle, gateway_ocsp_fail_open=None, allow_insecure_gateway=False

gateway!=native requires gateway_host; allow_insecure_gateway or http-on-non-loopback requires BENCHBOX_ALLOW_INSECURE_GATEWAY=1 plus loud warning; ocsp forwarded only when not None; missing CA bundle file raises

No live-vendor calls in tests; mock tokens only
